CHAPTER.VERS: And Jehoshaphat his son reigned in his stead, and strengthened himself against Israel.
And he placed forces in all the fortified cities of Judah, and set garrisons in the land of Judah, and in the cities of Ephraim, which Asa his father had taken.

And the LORD was with Jehoshaphat, because he walked in the first ways of his father David, and sought not to Baalim;
of…: or, of his father, and of David
But sought to the God of his father, and walked in his commandments, and not after the doings of Israel.

Therefore the LORD established the kingdom in his hand; and all Judah brought to Jehoshaphat tribute; and he had riches and honour in abundance.
brought: Heb. gave

And his heart was lifted up in the ways of the LORD: moreover he took away the high places and groves out of Judah.
was…: that is, was encouraged
Also in the third year of his reign he sent to his princes, to Benhail, and to Obadiah, and to Zechariah, and to Nethaneel, and to Michaiah, to teach in the cities of Judah.

And with them Levites, Shemaiah, and Nethaniah, and Zebadiah, and Asahel, and Shemiramoth, and Jehonathan, and Adonijah, and Tobijah, and Tobadonijah, Levites; and with them Elishama and Jehoram, priests.
And they taught in Judah, and the book of the law of the LORD with them, and went about throughout all the cities of Judah, and taught the people.

And the fear of the LORD fell upon all the kingdoms of the lands that around Judah, so that they made no war against Jehoshaphat.
fell: Heb. was
Also of the Philistines brought Jehoshaphat presents, and tribute silver; and the Arabians brought him flocks, seven thousand and seven hundred rams, and seven thousand and seven hundred male goats.

And Jehoshaphat became exceedingly great; and he built in Judah fortresses, and cities of store.
castles: or, palaces
And he had much business in the cities of Judah: and the men of war, mighty men of valour, in Jerusalem.
And these the numbers of them according to the house of their fathers: Of Judah, the captains of thousands; Adnah the chief, and with him mighty men of valour three hundred thousand.

And next to him Jehohanan the captain, and with him two hundred and eighty thousand.
next…: Heb. at his hand
And next to him Amasiah the son of Zichri, who willingly offered himself to the LORD; and with him two hundred thousand mighty men of valour.
And of Benjamin; Eliada a mighty man of valour, and with him armed men with bow and shield two hundred thousand.
And next to him Jehozabad, and with him an hundred and eighty thousand ready prepared for the war.
These waited on the king, besides whom the king put in the fortified cities throughout all Judah.
